subject: general
question: Which of the following is the main aim of the Memorandum of Understanding signed between the National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Intellectual Disabilities (Divyangjan) and the Jai Vakeel Foundation, in Mumbai in July 2025?

options.text: To roll out structured and uniform curriculum for children with intellectual disabilities
To train teachers in sign language and Braille for visually and hearing-impaired students
To establish a nationwide health insurance scheme for persons with disabilities
To launch a nationwide immunisation drive for children with disabilities

solution:
The correct answer is __**To roll out structured and uniform curriculum for children with intellectual disabilities**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Intellectual Disabilities (NIEPID)**, an autonomous body under the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment**, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the **Jai Vakeel Foundation** in **Mumbai** in **July 2024**.
 
• The primary objective of this collaboration is to roll out a **structured and uniform curriculum** for children with **intellectual disabilities** across the country.
 
• This initiative aims to standardize the educational framework for **Divyangjan**, ensuring that children with intellectual disabilities receive a consistent and high-quality education regardless of their **location**.
 
• The curriculum is designed to be **age-appropriate** and focuses on the **holistic development** of the child, covering academic, functional, and life skills.
